text: Snap-on Incorporated is a listed US company; its 2026 proxy statement names only The Vanguard Group (12.4%) and BlackRock (8.0%) as beneficial owners of more than 5% of its common stock, with no state or sovereign-fund holder.
short: Snap-on is NYSE-listed; Vanguard (12.4%) and BlackRock (8.0%) are its only >5% holders.

source.name: Snap-on Incorporated 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A, SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: The Vanguard Group, Inc. (2) 6,430,977 12.4% BlackRock, Inc. (3) 4,162,919 8.0%
source.note: From Table 2, 'Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management'; the table covers 'each person or entity known to us to be the beneficial owner of more than 5% of our common stock, as of the close of business on March 2, 2026'.
